name: i-have-dyslexia
description: Thinking strategies from dyslexic thinkers, and answers that work for dyslexic people: the point first, no red pen, ideas as pictures, small steps.

interface.longDescription: A library of thinking strategies shared by dyslexic people, for anyone who is stuck. For dyslexic readers, Codex also puts the answer first, never comments on spelling, draws ideas, and gives one step at a time.
defaultPrompt: I'm stuck. Think like a dyslexic thinker.
